name: fluffless-wp
description: Fluffless : thème Fluffless, extensions Fluffless Suite et Fluffless SEO.

scripts.php:install: docker compose run --rm php-tools composer install
scripts.analyse: docker compose run --rm php-tools vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=4G
scripts.i18n:pot: npm run i18n:pot:theme && npm run i18n:pot:tools && npm run i18n:pot:seo && npm run i18n:pot:consent
scripts.i18n:pot:consent: docker compose run --rm -T cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/fluffless-consent wp-content/plugins/fluffless-consent/languages/fluffless-consent.pot --slug=fluffless-consent --domain=fluffless-consent --exclude=vendor,node_modules,languages,tests
scripts.i18n:pot:theme: docker compose run --rm -T cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/themes/fluffless wp-content/themes/fluffless/languages/fluffless.pot --slug=fluffless --domain=fluffless --exclude=vendor,node_modules,languages
scripts.i18n:pot:seo: docker compose run --rm -T cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/fluffless-seo wp-content/plugins/fluffless-seo/languages/fluffless-seo.pot --slug=fluffless-seo --domain=fluffless-seo --exclude=vendor,node_modules,languages,tests
scripts.i18n:pot:tools: docker compose run --rm -T cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/fluffless-suite wp-content/plugins/fluffless-suite/languages/fluffless-suite.pot --slug=fluffless-suite --domain=fluffless-suite --exclude=vendor,node_modules,languages,tests && node tools/i18n-patterns-pot.mjs
scripts.i18n:update: docker compose run --rm -T cli sh -c 'wp i18n update-po wp-content/themes/fluffless/languages/fluffless.pot wp-content/themes/fluffless/languages && wp i18n update-po wp-content/plugins/fluffless-suite/languages/fluffless-suite.pot wp-content/plugins/fluffless-suite/languages && wp i18n update-po wp-content/plugins/fluffless-seo/languages/fluffless-seo.pot wp-content/plugins/fluffless-seo/languages && wp i18n update-po wp-content/plugins/fluffless-consent/languages/fluffless-consent.pot wp-content/plugins/fluffless-consent/languages'
scripts.i18n:build: docker compose run --rm -T cli sh -c 'for d in wp-content/themes/fluffless/languages wp-content/plugins/fluffless-suite/languages wp-content/plugins/fluffless-seo/languages wp-content/plugins/fluffless-consent/languages; do wp i18n make-mo $d && wp i18n make-php $d || exit 1; done; wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/fluffless-suite/languages --no-purge && wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/fluffless-seo/languages --no-purge'
